description: The wire model for progress events and reverse calls. 'descriptors' are judged by the Go contract (strict decoding, then the descriptor's own rules); the new members are an operation's 'progress' flag and the descriptor's 'reverse' list of host contracts. 'requests' are judged against 'requestDescriptor' (strict decoding, then the request's own rules); a valid request may carry a 'progress' rate and a 'parent', and 'reporter', 'events' and 'bytes' say whether the call gets a progress reporter and the rate with defaults filled in. A binding passes when it reproduces every outcome. Regenerate with EXT_UPDATE_FIXTURES=1 go test -run TestSDKFixtures ./pkg/ext-go/engine.

requests.name: a request that carries a rate
